zoe: Quick gut-check: for the new onboarding form should we do inline errors only or inline + top summary on submit? Compact layout is priority. mike: Inline by default. Add a summary only on submit when errors exist so we don't add visual noise. ariya: Agree. Summary should be keyboard-focusable and announce via role="alert". Also include anchors into fields. tom: A11y note: always include the word "required" in the accessible label, even if visually we show an asterisk. Screen readers need that. zoe: What about showing "(required)" as a suffix vs a separate small badge? Which is less noisy? mike: Suffix keeps layout stable. Badge is clearer visually but adds DOM elements. I'm for suffix. ariya: Implementation: keep `required` in the label for SRs; show a low-contrast suffix for sighted users. Hide/show toggles must not remove it from the accessibility tree. tom: Destructive flows: single item delete -> confirm modal + undo toast (30s). Bulk/org delete -> typed confirm (type org name) and explicit checkbox. zoe: Agreed reserve typed confirm for org-level. For bulk deletes we can show the modal with a checkbox + explain consequences. mike: Analytics: track `validation.summary_shown`, `validation.summary_link_click`, `delete.undo_clicked`. ariya: Small copy tweak for undo toast: "Key deleted. You can restore it within 30 seconds." Clearer than "Undo available". tom: Snippet for summary focus: `
2 errors. Go to Email
` zoe: I'll mock two variants: inline-only (summary on submit), and inline + persistent suffix. Will share comps tomorrow. design-bot: Created task D-678 for comps + a11y review.
